result.brief: 提出面向扩散语言模型的在线策略残差学习框架，通过熵收缩目标与异步残差捕获/传输系统，显著提升每前向token数与吞吐。
result.reason: Diffusion language model residual learning with on-policy training and entropy-contraction objective; touches continuous/latent residual context and diffusion LM training, transferable to continuous language modeling interests.
